content: Table 1 gives a summary of typical models for sentence pair modeling in recent years. In particular, we investigate five models in depth: two are representative of the sentence encoding type of model, and three are representative of the interaction-aggregation type of model. These models have reported state-or-the-art results with varied architecture design (this section) and implementation details (Section "Implementation Details" ).
